proposals.title: Paywall Fallback Swipes
proposals.oneLiner: Provide non-paying users with limited frontier model swipes in exchange for engagement when they decline the premium paywall.
proposals.trigger: Fires immediately after the user taps the decline option ('Not now') on the Janitor Plus paywall.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying, non-subscribed users who dismiss the premium subscription offer s04.

offer.title: Want 3 free swipes?
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to get 3 free swipes on our frontier models.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated purely on paywall decline (TAX-10). It is strictly capped at 2 instances (6 swipes) per day, ensuring the premium subscription's 'generous monthly swipes' promise remains a far superior, frictionless option.

kpis.holdout: Run a 5% user-level holdout group for 28 days to measure downstream subscription cannibalization and net revenue lift.

risks: Slight risk of micro-cannibalization among users who only need a couple of extra swipes per day, mitigated by the low daily cap.
Potential fatigue if users repeatedly see the offer on every paywall dismissal, mitigated by the 12-hour cooldown.

evidence.quote: Generous monthly swipes with our frontier models

proposals.title: Paywall Fallback Swipes
proposals.oneLiner: Provide non-paying users with limited base model swipes in exchange for engagement when they decline a premium paywall.

newMechanic.name: Base Model Swipes
newMechanic.description: A new consumable resource allowing limited interactions with a cheaper, base AI model. These are tracked per user, refresh daily, and are distinct from premium 'frontier model swipes'.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: To provide a valuable, low-cost rewarded item to non-paying users as an alternative to direct subscription, without cannibalizing the core premium offering.

proposals.trigger: Fires immediately after the user taps the decline option ('Close paywall' on s03 or 'Not now' on s04) on either Janitor Plus paywall.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying, non-subscribed users who dismiss the premium subscription offer from s03 or s04.

offer.title: Want 3 free swipes?
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to get 3 free swipes on our base models.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated purely on paywall decline (TAX-10). It is strictly capped at 2 instances (6 swipes) per day, ensuring the premium subscription's 'generous monthly swipes' promise remains a far superior, frictionless option. Rewards a cheaper 'base model swipe' instead of premium 'frontier model swipes'.

guardrails: Paywall s03 and s04 purchase conversion rate
kpis.holdout: Run a 5% user-level holdout group for 28 days to measure downstream subscription cannibalization and net revenue lift.

risks: Slight risk of micro-cannibalization among users who only need a couple of extra swipes per day, mitigated by the low daily cap.
Potential fatigue if users repeatedly see the offer on every paywall dismissal, mitigated by the 12-hour cooldown.

proposals.title: Daily Check-in Swipes
proposals.oneLiner: Earn 5 daily bonus frontier model swipes by playing a 15-second mini-game in the Profile menu.

newMechanic.name: Daily Check-in Swipes
newMechanic.description: A daily check-in feature on the Profile menu where users claim 5 bonus frontier model swipes after playing a short sponsored mini-game.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Janitor currently gates frontier model swipes behind the Janitor Plus subscription without any daily free check-in allowance for non-paying users.

proposals.trigger: User taps the 'Daily Check-in' card on s02 (Profile menu).
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying users who have not claimed today's check-in reward.

offer.title: Daily Check-in Swipes
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to claim 5 bonus frontier model swipes today.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Daily swipes are strictly capped at 5 per day, which lets non-payers sample frontier AI responses without replacing Janitor Plus's generous monthly swipes, 5x context memory, priority routing, or golden badge.

kpis.primary: Daily active user retention (D7/D30) and check-in completion rate on s02.
guardrails: Frontier model API token cost per active user

risks: Frontier model LLM token costs for 5 swipes per completed view
User disappointment if daily check-in swipes do not roll over to the next day
